comparison: Matched asymmetric control over Rung 1 (2/13) and Rung 2 (4/13) vs unified-v11 (16/16 PASS).
conclusion: Rung 3a (law4_sgd_g_equil_d: pure unnormalized SGD on G, exact unified_v11_equil on D and row-normalized prior, 0 G secant band, 0 G states) scores 5/13 executed PASS (8 numerical FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE/TIMEOUT, 3 prereq-gated) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Equilibrating D+prior rescues img_bars4 (0/4 -> 4/4 hq=1.0000 PASS), nash_overpowered_critic_ring16 (NaN -> 16/16 hq=0.9783 PASS), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (0/4 -> 4/4 hq=0.9609 PASS), and vector_unequal_mass/width (hq=0.9983/0.9973 PASS) even with pure unnormalized SGD on G. However, without G secant regulation or per-layer G normalization, pure SGD on G still collapses nash_overpowered_generator_ring16 (8/16 hq=0.3672), grid100 (prec=0.1358), ring16_acquisition (14/16 hq=0.6897, D outruns unnormalized G), five_word_joint_smoke (4/5 tv=0.2172), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0=1.4142), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (4/4 hq=0.9648, eig=0.4035), gaussian1d_smoke (ks=0.0718), and zero_tanh_smoke.
